evidence_class: live Anton cluster-autoscaler v1.33.0 and the anton-k3s-swarm ASG

known_failures.one_node_for_one_worker: a new swarm node turns Ready before kata-deploy labels it katacontainers.io/kata-runtime=true, so the autoscaler counts no upcoming node for the still-pending worker and raises the group once more; the extra node stays empty and the ordinary scale-down removes it. Accepted as a known limitation by the swarm master on 2026-10-11; the startup taint fix is its own task
